description.value: Grabenhorst Garden is a free, publicly accessible community garden operated by the City of Pitt Meadows, situated on Harris Road in the agricultural lowlands of Pitt Meadows. As a municipal green space, it offers a peaceful stop amid the flat, dyke-road cycling terrain of the lower Fraser Valley. Dogs are not permitted on site.
